in_hebrew.name: ליב
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Lib is derived from the Hebrew word 'ליב' (leib), which means 'heart'. This name reflects the deep spiritual connection between God and His people, emphasizing the importance of a heart that is fully devoted to Him.

in_greek.name: λείβ
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Lib in Greek is derived from the word 'λείβ' (leib), which also means 'heart'. In the context of the Bible, this name can represent the spiritual depth and devotion to God, symbolizing a heart that is pure and open to His will.

in_latin.name: Libra
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Lib in Latin is derived from the word 'Libra', which means 'balances'. This name is not directly related to the biblical name Lib, but it does share the same first two letters. In the context of the Bible, this name could represent the idea of balance or justice in the context of God's law and His plan for His people.
